description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
